Module example.com/cgobindings has packages that cgo bindings mode
(CGO_ENABLED=bindings) loads with and without their import "C" files.
See cgo_bindings_index.txt.
-- .mod --
module example.com/cgobindings

go 1.28
-- .info --
{"Version":"v1.0.0"}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgobindings

go 1.28
-- withcfiles/bind.go --
package withcfiles

// #include <stdlib.h>
import "C"

//cgo:func Abs abs libc
func Abs(int32) int32
-- withcfiles/cfile.c --
int unused;
-- withc/withc.go --
package withc

// static int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }
-- withc/fallback.go --
//go:build !cgo

package withc

func One() int { return 1 }
-- fallback/bind.go --
//go:build cgo || cgobindings

package fallback

import "C"

//cgo:func abs abs libc
func abs(int32) int32

func Abs(x int32) int32 { return abs(x) }
-- fallback/nocgo.go --
//go:build !cgo && !cgobindings

package fallback

func Abs(x int32) int32 {
	if x < 0 {
		return -x
	}
	return x
}
